svg.title: Figure 4 | A verifiable design requirement
svg.desc: Who uses it → what they do → what difficulty they face → what to change → how to test it

g.font-family: Arial, Noto Sans CJK TC, sans-serif
g.text: Who uses it → what they do → what difficulty they face → what to change
User: a case worker using the system for the first time
Task: identify and correct the missing document type
Problem: the user does not know which field is incomplete
Candidate change: show a specific error and correction guidance beside
Verification: give a missing-information scenario and observe whether
the user can correct it independently
